column2: [8] Tightening the Noose

Mobile Infantry forces are relentlessly closing the net around the Brain Bug’s last refuge.

Total victory is within reach, but a great struggle remains in the ruined center of Mahanagar. The first step is to establish a base on the fittingly named “Liberty Square”.
Capture Liberty Square
Do not lose Liberty Square

You've worked hard to get us here, Keys. My troops are happy to take it from here if you feel you're better served elsewhere.
And keep me from all the fun? Come on now, Major. You know you're not keeping me back, at this point.
Ha. I'd expect no less, soldier. Gimme tabs on our slug friend, then. I wanna hear how he's screaming with every stinkin' Bug we crush!
Here we go, Brain Bug. Last place left to run, and the mighty fist of the M.I. is knocking on your door!
We'll restore order in the city center by first retaking Liberty Square from the bastards. They'll be forced to slink back to their Bug hole after that.
Liberty Square ain't going anywhere anytime soon now. Bring forward our firepower there for the final assault!
Bug attack incoming! Keep 'em out of the square!
We've handed the Bugs victory at Liberty Square with ease! Shameful conduct!
Liberty Square is free of Bug scum!
They'll be back in force, Major. The Brain Bug is getting desperate.
Good, cos' I've got plenty turrets to tear up anything it sends this way!
We can't give the Bugs time to regroup. Let's hit 'em hard now and wipe each sector of hives!
SAM sites up and firing. Tell Fleet they're welcome to start helping out now!
First SAM site is up!
Fleet wants to send aerial support our way, but they won't while there are Bugs in the sky.
Figures that those flyboys want a shot at glory once the ball's on the one yard line already.
Fine, let's put up SAM sites and clear the skies for 'em.
All clear up here! Now just one last stinkin' Bug hole left to cleanse...
It's time to end this thing. The Brain Bug's responsible for the blood of thousands of innocents, all my friends, and the decimation of my city; I need to see its face when it dies.
You're almost sounding like a real soldier, Sergeant.
That's most of the city center cleared. The Bugs are all turning tail!
The Brain Bug is pulling everything to a final defense above its lair. I can feel him shaking; he's terrified of what's coming!
That's the first damn thing he's got right yet! We're coming to squash every last one of his dirty Bugs left!
Liberty Square ain't going anywhere anytime soon now. Bring forward our firepower there for the final assault!
Ha! If our slug friend wasn't scared before, he will be now -- Marauders are ready to join the fight!
